brief:
The Wall and Settlement Resistance Commission reported that settlers have shot and killed 25 Palestinians in the West Bank since the beginning of 2026. The deaths occurred across the occupied territory in recent months.

The figure represents a continuation of deadly violence by Israeli settlers against Palestinians. Settler attacks and gunfire have killed Palestinians consistently since 2019, with the tally continuing to mount this year.
